sections.title: Quantum modular forms
sections.extract: []{#sub.QMF label="sub.QMF"} Quantum modular forms are fascinating objects introduced by Zagier [@Za:QMF]. In the simplest formulation, a quantum modular form is a complex valued function $f$ on the set of complex roots of unity that comes equipped with a suitable formal power series expansion $\phi_\zeta(\hbar) \in \mathbb C[\![\hbar]\!]$ at each complex root of unity $\zeta$. sections.title: State integrals
sections.extract: Complex Chern-Simons theory has not yet been made mathematically rigorous as a full TQFT, in contrast to Chern-Simons theory with a compact gauge group [@Witten-jones] and the Reshetikhin-Turaev construction [@RT]. Nevertheless, there exist state-integral models, based on ideal triangulations, that provide a definition of complex Chern-Simons partition functions for a certain class of 3-manifolds [@D-levelk; @AK].
